# NBA Hardwood Dog Tags
> Dog tags with a back of reclaimed NBA court hardwood and a printed team mark on the front. All 30 teams in silver, black and 24K gold. Currently open for free reservations ahead of a Kickstarter launch.

- [Home](https://scotttischler.com/nbatags/): overview, finishes, FAQ
- [Collection](https://scotttischler.com/nbatags/collection.html): all 30 teams
- [The wood](https://scotttischler.com/nbatags/story.html): where the hardwood comes from
- [Reserve](https://scotttischler.com/nbatags/preorder.html): free reservation, no payment taken
- [Contact](https://scotttischler.com/nbatags/contact.html)

Facts: first run cut from a panel of the 2011 NBA All-Star Game court, sourced through NBALAB. Pricing is announced at Kickstarter launch. Images marked concept render are illustrations.
